name: Sheep N Shag
source:
Meet Carla.

A 23 year old Chilean sheep who's currently studying to be a music teacher.
After seeing one of her ads online for teaching practice, you decide to test your luck and pay her a visit to see if you can learn a thing or two.

However, things take a turn for the horn-y.

[From [url=https://bezerk.itch.io/sheep-n-shag]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
认识卡拉。

一只23岁的智利绵羊，目前正在学习成为一名音乐老师。
在网上看到她的一则教学实践广告后，你决定试试运气并拜访她，看看你是否可以学到一两件事。

然而，事情却出现了转机。

[来自[url=https://bezerk.itch.io/sheep-n-shag]itch.io[/url]]
